ground.intro: Let’s come back to right here. Five small steps, one at a time. Go as slowly as you like.

steps.prompt: Look around slowly. Name five things you can see, big or small.
Notice four things you can feel: your feet on the floor, your clothes, the chair, the air.
Listen for three sounds, near or far. Let them be whatever they are.
Find two smells. If nothing comes, just notice the air as you breathe in.
Notice one taste in your mouth right now, or take a sip of water.

ground.finish: You’re here, right now. Notice how you feel.
